query: UPDATE forms SET description = COALESCE($2, description), confirmation_message = COALESCE($3, confirmation_message), audience = COALESCE($4, audience), status = COALESCE($5, status), closes_at = CASE WHEN $6 THEN $7 ELSE closes_at END, tally_visible = COALESCE($8, tally_visible), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1
